biography_summary: 内维尔·蔡（Neville Choi）是巴布亚新几内亚资深媒体人，现任巴布亚新几内亚媒体委员会（MCPNG）主席，同时担任蔡媒体解决方案（Choi Media Solutions）管理合伙人、媒体培训师及托克皮辛语翻译专家。Choi早年在美国CNN亚特兰大总部接受新闻专业培训，此后在PNG主流媒体积累丰富从业经验，曾在媒体新几内亚有限公司（EMTV）和巴布亚新几内亚矿业与石油商会等工作。2022年，Choi当选MCPNG主席，启动了媒体委员会十余年沉寂后的全面重组进程。在他的领导下，MCPNG完成了章程审查和更新（2022-2024）、制定并通过了新版《职业道德与执业准则》（2024年）、建立了独立投诉法庭、恢复了PNG全国新闻俱乐部和PNG媒体奖项、创办了年度PNG媒体峰会（2025年首届）、推动全国媒体认证制度建设，并与BBC Media Action合作开展记者社交媒体培训。Choi积极倡导新闻自由和媒体独立，多次公开呼吁政府停止打压媒体工作者，推动媒体自律与政府支持之间的建设性对话。2026年，他将PNG媒体峰会升级为太平洋地区性活动，使巴布亚新几内亚在太平洋地区媒体自由与发展中发挥引领作用。Choi常驻莫尔兹比港。

collection_meta.notes: Profile of Neville Choi, President/Chairman of the Media Council of Papua New Guinea (MCPNG). LinkedIn confirms he is Managing Partner at Choi Media Solutions, Media Trainer, Tok Pisin Translation Specialist, educated at CNN Atlanta, based in Port Moresby. RocketReach confirms prior experience at PNG Chamber of Mines and Petroleum and Media Niugini Limited (EMTV). His tenure as MCPNG President since 2022 is well-documented through multiple sources: mcpng.net official site, PINA, PNG Hausbung, Post-Courier, NBC PNG, and ABC Pacific. Key reforms include: Constitution review, Code of Ethics 2024 update, Independent Complaints Tribunal establishment, PNG National Press Club revival, PNG Media Awards return after 13 years, inaugural PNG Media Summit 2025 (upgraded to Pacific regional event in 2026), media accreditation system, and BBC Media Action training partnership. Birth date, exact start dates at earlier positions not publicly available.
